sourceTitle: Financial assistance for foster carers (East Ayrshire Council)

fees.label: Household fee: three or more children

feesNote: East Ayrshire pays one weekly fee per fostering household, set by how many children are living there, on top of the allowance paid for each child.
extras: Start-up payments towards household items (no amount published)
Travel expenses towards fuel costs (no amount published)
summary: East Ayrshire pays each child's allowance at the Scottish Recommended Allowance rates for 2026 to 2027, and adds a weekly household fee that rises with the number of children placed. A carer looking after one child aged 5 to 15 would receive the £206.71 allowance plus the £280 household fee.
